bge_reranker.node_purpose: Score every bounded candidate against every compiled RetrievalNeed under the current provider-neutral financial ontology.
bge_reranker.input_scale: Eighteen development atoms plus one bounded complex-document replay; at most ten needs and ninety-six candidates per atom.
required_outputs: one finite score per candidate-need pair
bge_reranker.schema_burden: pair-score matrix, stable candidate and need identities, cache digest and complete ordering
bge_reranker.materiality_and_quality_risk: a generic margin, mix or product phrase can outrank a direct operating result or leave a valid candidate outside the review surface
bge_reranker.comparable_run_evidence: v1.5 reached complete candidate-pool recall but exposed an incomplete operating-margin and management-call semantic contract in the VS1 replay
bge_reranker.reasoning_profile: local CUDA cross-encoder scoring without generation, network or training; CPU fallback is prohibited
bge_reranker.stop_and_truncation: 1024 tokens per pair, batch 2, finite matrix; fail closed when CUDA, score shape, identity or lineage is unavailable

qwen_reranker.node_purpose: Provide an independent all-needs relevance signal over the same finite candidate matrix.
qwen_reranker.input_scale: The same bounded candidate-need matrices as BGE.
required_outputs: one finite score per candidate-need pair
qwen_reranker.schema_burden: instruction-aware pair scores, deterministic aggregation and cache receipt
qwen_reranker.materiality_and_quality_risk: semantic proximity may prefer a generic risk paragraph or detached row, so this score never owns Evidence truth
qwen_reranker.comparable_run_evidence: v1.5 showed generic Qwen improved recall but still required financial intent and role adjudication
qwen_reranker.reasoning_profile: local CUDA reranker shadow without generation, network or training; CPU fallback is prohibited
qwen_reranker.stop_and_truncation: 1024 tokens per pair, batch 2, finite matrix; fail closed when CUDA, score shape, identity or lineage is unavailable

why_new_attempt_is_justified: the VS1 replay exposed provider-neutral operating-margin and first-party management-call surfaces missing from ontology v1.1
ontology v1.2 can change typed recall and candidate-need pairing, so the old ranking cannot be relabelled
the user requires local vector and reranker computation to run on CUDA without silent CPU fallback
not_changed: compiled object population and reviewed labels
hard identity, period, source and relationship filters
candidate, Evidence and NumericFact authority boundaries
